clues.text: Joseph, a Levite the apostles called Barnabas, came from here and sold a field for the church.
Sent out by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul sailed here from Seleucia and preached in Salamis synagogues.
At Paphos on this island, Barnabas and Saul met the sorcerer Bar-Jesus, attendant of proconsul Sergius Paulus.
After a sharp disagreement with Paul, Barnabas took Mark and sailed off to this place.
Men from here and Cyrene went to Antioch and began telling Greeks the good news about Jesus.
Sailing toward Italy as a prisoner, Paul's ship passed in the lee of this island because of contrary winds.
Balaam's oracle said ships would come from the coasts of this land and subdue Asshur and Eber.
